normalization.leaf_rule: scalar, null, empty array, and empty object values are leaves
normalization.aggregation: one entry per unique normalized path; source_value_kinds and occurrence_count aggregate all occurrences

resolved_contract_gaps.title: Outcome-conditional sparse rejected manual-expense operations
resolved_contract_gaps.implemented_change: Implemented outcome-conditional manual_expense operations: accepted and no_change retain the strict closed input; rejected requires operation_class=rejection, forbids input, requires the closed sparse attempted_input with request_id, and requires outcome.field_path plus reason_code. Missing currency, time, and note remain absent rather than being synthesized.
alternatives: Add a separate manual_expense_attempt action type with its own closed sparse input and rejection class.
Keep invalid attempts outside the v2 operation graph as test-only data, losing unified complete-state atomic-rejection evidence.
Encode field and reason into one field-qualified reason_code, losing structured field_path semantics.
resolved_contract_gaps.risk: A non-conditional sparse input could weaken accepted/no_change validation; an open-ended attempted_input would break the closed-contract invariant; collapsing field and reason would reduce machine-readable validation detail.

resolved_contract_gaps.title: Approval of collapsed v1 economic-time expansion
resolved_contract_gaps.implemented_change: Implemented the approved RG-01-only collapsed-time mapping: each mapped v1 occurred_at exact timestamp text expands to transaction_version.occurred_at, statistics_at, and effective_at. This is not a general migration default, and created_at or confirmed_at are not generated.
alternatives: Reject RG-01 migration until independent occurred_at, statistics_at, and effective_at facts are supplied.
Preserve only occurred_at and amend the v2 contract to make the other economic-time roles optional for migrated RG-01 records.
resolved_contract_gaps.risk: Unapproved expansion could silently invent report attribution or balance-effective semantics; rejection delays migration but avoids semantic overclaiming.

resolved_contract_gaps.title: Deterministic normalized migration locator
resolved_contract_gaps.implemented_change: Implemented normalized source locator grammar using $, .key, and [*], plus stable occurrence discriminators. Root UUIDv5 names use case-id + newline + @root + newline + root + newline + semantic-key; descendant names use case-id, root-id, entity-kind, and semantic-key. Public helpers validate and generate both forms.
alternatives: Require every v1 structural object to be pre-enriched with an explicit stable ID before migration.
Freeze authored human-readable IDs for every generated root/state/operation/entity, increasing manual mapping surface and collision review.
resolved_contract_gaps.risk: Calling wildcard locators JSON Pointer is incorrect; using real array indexes or traversal order makes IDs unstable under semantically irrelevant reordering; changing helper rules can affect all future adapters.

resolved_contract_gaps.title: Approved expected-output status
resolved_contract_gaps.implemented_change: Implemented approval_status as draft_for_review or approved. approved is used only after independent expected-output review and explicit user approval and is distinct from rule_version or frozen business-rule status.
alternatives: Keep expected outputs permanently draft_for_review and record approval only outside the case document.
Add a separate reviewed manifest that references the draft case hash, increasing publication and integrity machinery.
resolved_contract_gaps.risk: Without an approved status the serialized expected output cannot express its gate state; changing status without review would falsely authorize migration output.
